answer: A canyon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quartz of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch.
